code:
def largestPalindrome(n: int) -> int:
    if n == 1:
        return 9
    
    upper = pow(10, n) - 1
    lower = pow(10, n - 1)
    pal = None
    found = False
    result = -1
    
    i = upper
    while i >= lower:
        s = str(i)
        pal = int(s + s[::-1])
        
        j = upper
        sqrt_pal = int(pal ** 0.5)
        
        while j <= sqrt_pal:
            if pal % j == 0 and len(str(pal // j)) == n:
                result = pal % 1337
                found = True
                break
            j += 1
        
        if found:
            break
        i -= 1
    
    return result

verification.note: ILR确有错：内层循环标称'j从upper到sqrt(pal)'但node14是j+=1（应递减），且全程无i-=1、外层无法推进，还缺少j本身必须是n位数的守卫——n=3时i=999,pal=999999会接受j=1001(4位数)这一非法因子，输出1260而非123。代码额外偏离ILR：加了while j<=sqrt_pal上界但j从upper递增，upper>sqrt(pal)循环体永不执行，n=2/3都返回-1。
verification.evidence: ILR忠实模拟n=3：j从999递增到1001即命中非法因子，result=1260(期望123)；生成代码 largestPalindrome(2)=-1(期望987)、largestPalindrome(3)=-1(期望123)。
